parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm at about 75 bpm with ST elevation and broad, tall, hyperacute-looking T waves in II, III and aVF, and reciprocal ST depression with T inversion in aVL (and lead I). This is not a normal ECG, and the inferior ST elevation meets the ≥1 mm criterion in two contiguous leads.
